recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見數個核圓、不分葉或僅雙葉的小型巨核細胞，旁邊有核染色質較開放的母細胞與紅血球前驅細胞，小型低分葉巨核細胞提示 inv(3)/t(3;3) AML。
features: Several megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or bilobed nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Intermixed immature cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei
Hypercellular marrow spaces between fat vacuoles
Black granular pigment deposits, most likely fixative artifact or hemosiderin
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a cellular marrow containing numerous immature mononuclear cells with open chromatin, admixed with erythroid precursors. Megakaryocytes are conspicuous and dysplastic, with small size and round monolobated or bilobed nuclei. Black granular deposits consistent with fixative pigment are present. Findings are suggestive of AML with inv(3)(q21q26.2)/t(3;3)(q21;q26.2), GATA2::MECOM, pending blast enumeration and cytogenetic correlation.

ddx.vs: del(5q) has similar hypolobated megakaryocytes but low blast counts and a del(5q) karyotype.
MPN megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated (staghorn) or hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei rather than small monolobated forms, and blasts are not increased.
Multilineage dysplasia is shared, and only cytogenetic demonstration of 3q26 MECOM rearrangement assigns the specific entity.
